patch:
diff --git a/evals/tasks/05-duplicate-orders/fixture/queries.py b/evals/tasks/05-duplicate-orders/fixture/queries.py
index 55fa844..8483c52 100644
--- a/evals/tasks/05-duplicate-orders/fixture/queries.py
+++ b/evals/tasks/05-duplicate-orders/fixture/queries.py
@@ -5,7 +5,6 @@ def orders_for_customer(customer):
     """All orders belonging to `customer`."""
     rows = []
     for order in ORDERS:
-        owner = next(c for c in CUSTOMERS if c["id"] == order["customer_id"])
-        if owner["name"] == customer["name"]:
+        if order["customer_id"] == customer["id"]:
             rows.append(order)

verification: Before fix: 6 report lines (101/102 twice), total 290, both Acme customers saw both orders. After fix: run_tests.py passed; 4 lines; total 165; no duplicate order IDs; correct per-customer isolation; 'All 5 verification tests passed'.
